title: Authentication and authorization run outside Databricks, on Azure
statement: User authentication and authorization — including the authorization API and Azure External ID — sit outside the Databricks deployment, in Azure, because there is no advantage to placing them inside Databricks. This is the named exception to running everything in Databricks. The public application UI is likewise a separate deployment outside the Databricks deployment.
